m: 1. रस् (cf. √ 1. रास्) cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xvii, 63) रसति (rarely Ā. ˚ते; pf. ररास, रेसुः, MBh. &c.; aor. अरासीत् or अरसीत् Gr.; fut. रसिता, रसिष्यति, ib.; inf. रसितुम्, ib.), to roar, yell, cry, sound, reverberate, ŚBr. &c. &c.; to praise, Naigh. iii, 14 : Caus. रासयति (aor. अरीरसत्), Gr.: Desid. रिरसिषति, ib. : Intens. रारस्यते (or रारस्ति, Gr.), to cry out loudly, scream aloud, Bhaṭṭ.

a: रस् — {vI.v} {c1c} P. (रसति, रसित) 1 To roar, yell, cry out, scream; करीव वन्यः परुषं ररास R. 16. 78; Śi. 3. 41. --2 To sound, make a noise, tinkle, jingle &c.; राजन्योपनिमंत्रणाय रसति स्फीतं यशोदुंदुभिः Ve. 1. 25; रसतां निर्भरं नूपुराणां Ratn. 1. 19; रसतु रसनापि तव घन जघनमंडले Gīt. 10 --3 To resound, reverberate. --4 To sing. --5 Ved. bahavo rasasAmarTyAddivyaM dehamASritya jIvanmuktimASritAH SrUyante raseSvarasidDAnte “devAH kecismaheSAdyA dEtyAH kAvyapuraHsarAH । munayo bAlaKilyAdyA nfpAH someSvarAdayaH । govindaBagavatpAdAcAryyo govindanAmakaH । carvawiH kapilo vyAqiH kApAliH kandalAyanaH । ete'nye bahavaH sidDA jIvanmuktAScaranti hi । tanuM rasamayImApya tadAtmaka kaTAcaRAH” iti । ayamevAsyArTaH parameSvareRa parameSvarIM prati prapaYcitaH' । itaHparo granTaH pAradaSabde 4313 pf॰ darSitaH । tatprapaYcastu govindaBagavatpAdAcAryyasarvajYarAmeSvaraBawwArakapraBftimiH prAcInErAcAryyErnirUpita iti granTaBUyastvaBayAdudAsyate । na ca rasaSAstraM DAtuvAdArTameveti mantavyaM dehabanDadvArA muktereva paramapayojanatvAt taduktaM rasArRave “lohavanDastvayA deva! yaddattaM paramISitaH! । taM dehabanDamAcakzva yena syAt KecarI gatiH । yaTA lohe taTA dehe karttavyaH sUtakaH satA । samAnaM kurute devi! pratyayaM dehalohayoH । pUrvaM lohe parIkzeta paScAddehe prayojayet” iti । nanu saccidAnandAtmakaparatattvasPuraRAdeva muktisidDO kimanena divyadehasampAdanaprayAseneti cettadetadavArttaM vArttaSarIrAlABe tadvArttAyA ayogAt । taduktaM rasahfdaye “galitAnalpavikalpaH sarvADvavivarjitaScidAnandaH । sPurito'pyasPuritatanoH karoti kiM jantuvargasyeti । yaM jarayA jarjaritaM kAsaSvAsAdiduHKaviSadaYca । yogyaM taM na samADO pratihatabudDIndriyaprasaram । bAlaH zoqaSavarzo vizayarasAKAdalampawaH parataH । yAtaviveko vfdDo martyaH kaTamApnuyAnmuktimiti” । nanu jIvatvaM nAma saMsAritvaM tadviparItatvaM muktatvaM taTAca parasparavirudDayoH kaTamekAyatanatvamupapannaM syAditi cettadanupapannaM vikalpAnupapatteH muktistAvat sarvatIrTakarasammatA sA kiM jYeyapade niviSate na vA carame SaSavizARakalpA syAt praTame na jIvanaM varjanIyamajIvato jYAtftvAnupapatteH । taduktaM raseSvarasidDAnte “rasANkameyamArgokte jIvamokzo'styaDomanAH । pramARAntaravAdezu yuktiBedAvalambizu । jYAnajYeyamidaM vidDi sarvatantrezu sammatam । nAjIvan jYAsyati jYeyaM yadato'styeva jIvanam” iti । na cedamadfzwacaramiti mantavyaM vizRutvAmimatAnusAriBiH nfpaYcAsyaSarIrasya nityatvopapAdanAt । taduktam sAkArasidDO “saccinnityanijAcintyapUrRAnandEkavigraham । nfpaYcAsyamahaM vande SrIvizRusvAmisammatam” iti । nanvetat sAvayavaM rUpavadavaBAsamAnaM nfkaRWIravANgaM saditi na saNgacCata ityAdinAkzepapuraHsaraM sanakAdipratyakzeRa “sahasraSIrzA puruzaH” ityAdiSrutyA “tamadButaM bAlakamambujekzaRaM caturBujaM SaNKagadAdyadAyuDam” ityAdipurARalakzaRena pramARatrayeRa sidDaM nfpaYcAnanANgaM kaTamasat syAditi । sadAdIni viSezaRAni garBaSrIkAntamiSrEH vizRusvAmicaraRapariRatAntaHkaraREH pratipAditAni । tasmAdasmadizwadehanityatvamatyantAdfzwaM na BavatIti puruzArTakAmukEH puruzErezwavyam । ata evoktam “AyatanaM vidyAnAMmUlaM DarmArTakAmamokzARAm । SreyaH paraM kimanyacCarIramajarAmaraM vihAyEkamiti” । ajarAmarIkaraRasamarTaSca rasendra eva tadAha “eko'sO rasarAjaH SarIramajarAmaraM kurute” iti । kiM varRyate rasasya mAhAtmyaM yasya darSanasparSanAdinApi mahat PalaM Bavati । taduktaM rasArRave “darSanAt sparSanAttasya BakzaRAt smaraRAdapi । pUjanAdrasadAnAcca dfSyate zaqviDaM Palam । kedArAdIni liNgAni pfTivyAM yAni kAnicit । tAni dfzwvA tu yatpuRyaM tat puRyaM rasadarSanAdityAdinA” । anyatrApi “kASyAdisarvaliNgeByo rasaliNgArcanaM Sivam । prApyate yena talliNgaM BogArogyAmftAjaram” iti । rasani॰ ndAyAH pratyavAyo'pi darSitaH “pramAdAdrasanindAyAH SrutAvenaM smaret suDIH । drAk tyajennindakaM nityaM nindayA pUritASuBam” iti । tasmAdasmaduktayA rItyA divyaM paramaM jyotiHsvaBAvamavikalpam । vigalitasakalakleSaM jYeyaM SAntaM svasaMvedyam । tasminnADAya manaH sPuradaKilaM cinmayaM jagat paSyan । utsannakarmabanDo brahmatvamihEva cApnotIti” । SrutiSca “raso vE saH rasaM hyevAyaM labDvAnandI BavatIti” । taditTaM Bave nAnyoduHKaBarataraRopAyo rasa eveti sidDam । taTAca rasasya parabrahmaRA sAmyamiti pratipAdakaH SlokaH “yaH syAt prAvaraRAvimocanaDiyAM sADyaH prakftyA punaH sampanno sahate na dIvyati paraM vESvAnare jAgrati । jAto yadyaparaM na vedayati ca svasmAt svayaM dyotate yo brahmEva sa dEnyasaMsftiBayAt pAyAdasO pAradaH” iti ।
